description: Lucien exposes Dolores' sin of robbing others of their will in the name of justice, Peropha tries to excuse her, Hidariva only wants a direct fight, clashing values intensely conflict

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8, why are you late? Why are you late? She hurriedly emerged from the nearby village, with irregular lumps of flesh pulsating under her cloak on both shoulders, chest, and back. "player3! Your spell worked!" She rushed over, hugged player3, and two slits opened on each of her cheeks. Three mouths spoke in unison, "Great, now I have four hearts, so I can love each of you with a separate heart... I understand now that sometimes everyone was afraid to accept my feelings because I didn't love everyone enough... Now I can do it..." Noticing the tense atmosphere, she looked around in panic. "What's wrong? Why is everyone making that face? Aren't we supposed to be together forever?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh! How could this be!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 looked at Landriel with confusion and even a bit of disgust, quietly retreating behind player5.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: "Yes, I lied. I didn't erase everyone's memories..." player8 lowered her head and twisted her hands. "I thought, I thought that as long as our hearts could understand each other, someday we could accept each other's actions..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "But if you didn't erase my memory... then who did it... and... how did you become like this!?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh! Little player8, you're finally here! player4 said she wants to disband the adventuring party. Quick, talk her out of it! Didn't we agree to stay together forever?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Not Landriel?" "Then, the person I saw back then..." "...Who was it?" player3 took a step back, looking around at the circle of people in horror. "The ones I love aren't everyone?" "Is it someone else?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "But if you didn't erase my memory... then who did it... and... how did you become like this!?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh...? Who was it? Who was it? But does it matter? It doesn't matter, little player3! Everyone is here now, right?" "No matter what happened in the past, isn't it enough if we just form an adventuring party together for a lifetime?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Yes... no... The ones I love aren't everyone? Why is everyone not everyone?..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh, huh? What are you saying, little Dolores? How could everyone not be everyone? Look, who else besides little player8 can turn themselves into three mouths and four hearts?"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...What are you talking about?" player3 looked at player2 with a face wrinkled in alarm and confusion. "Her ability is to alter others' memories, isn't it..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Cheer up, little player8! You only have three mouths now, which is still a bit few compared to your four hearts. If you had four mouths, you could kiss all four of us at the same time!" "Huh? Isn't it about fiddling with her potions? There are ones that make people forget the past, and ones that make you grow extra mouths and hearts, right?" "I thought you all knew!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 looked at the inhuman Landriel, then at Dolores hiding behind him, and couldn't help but let out a bitter laugh. "All this time, I've been fighting alongside people like this... I always thought everything I did was in pursuit of justice... But I can't even see the path I'm walking clearly... How can I know where this path will lead me... I don't even understand the people around me..."

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 was deeply hurt. "player3, you agreed to cast this spell on me. How could you forget? Do you always disregard our memories like this..." She then turned to player5. "What's going on, what's going on? That night I sneaked into your room... well, maybe not exactly sneaked... just to discuss player3's spell with you. Didn't you promise me to silently support player3 together with everyone? Why, why does no one remember..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "It seems we still don't understand each other well enough... As long as we get to know each other better, we can definitely stay together forever!"

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: @player3 Not Healing +1 I love you, and everyone! +3 (That's why I'm speed-grilling)

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "What do you mean you sneaked into my room? Why don't I remember any of it! What did you do to me!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: (Peropha just wants to be with everyone! No matter what everyone becomes, we must stay together!) player8 "Why doesn't everyone remember?" player8 looked around in confusion, her eyes glowing as she activated her spell. "Let me see... I remember every single moment spent with everyone clearly... Let me see if you've all forgotten..." Intent: Hack into everyone's minds to see what their memories have become. Calamity: Due to her current deformed state, the spell fails, making everyone suspect she is a companion who arbitrarily alters their memories.

conversation.speaker: player8
conversation.text: player8 saw the scene in player3's mind: player8 telling her that she had already erased everyone's memories, and no one else would know... She then saw in player5's memory that he had agreed to player8's request to support player3 together, but player5's eyes had long lost their sparkle, only showing the dazed confusion of someone whose mind had been manipulated... player8 screamed and cried loudly. So she had just been abusing her ability all along. Rather than having everyone support player3, she had actually planted suggestions, making everyone intentionally or unintentionally ignore what she did, only remembering at the very end... Not only that, she had also erased her own memory of promising player3. Was the happiness with everyone just a fantasy she fabricated on her own? The pulsating lumps of flesh on player8 exploded with her scream, splattering all over her companions, leaving her奄奄一息地趴在地上.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (Mom! player8 exploded! @player2 player6 count 2 Why can't we all be together? +3 (I don't know.)

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: player3 froze in place. The implanted suggestions began to gradually fade. "The ones I love aren't everyone? The ones I love are... the controlled everyone? The everyone I love... died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died, died." "Don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die, don't die..." player3 gathered Landriel's shattered pieces. Her own arms shattered, transforming into healing power, healing one of Landriel's arms.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: player4 is having a bit of trouble understanding the current scene and might need some time to digest it—oh no, can't digest it anymore, vomiting.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: But before she could be completely cured, player3's life force was completely exhausted, and she died.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Huh, huh? Could it be that my memory often being jumbled is the result of little player8's ability going out of control? Good thing I keep a diary every day and record all this! Wait, now doesn't seem to be the time to talk about this, little Dolores, little player8, how are you both dead?!"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: player5 gradually recalled everything that had happened before, everything he witnessed, and everything Landriel had done to him. His trembling hands could barely hold the sword, but he felt an oddly calm heart. It was time to end all this.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "No, with five missing two, how can we all stay together..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Intent: Kill everyone, Disaster: Can't beat you, committed suicide.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: Just don't kill me.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Oh! I get it! As long as we all go down to find them... we can be together forever and ever again!"
